collocations.reason: Standard accounting collocation for recording an entry on the credit side.
Commonly used when reconciling accounts against credit items or credit balances.
Natural operational expression for tallying up credit side amounts.

examples.reason: Natural business phrasing describing month-end book reconciliation and verification of credit entries/balances.
'貸方を適正に処理いたしました' is a hollow, formulaic template. In Japanese accounting practice, one does not speak of 'processing the credit side' as a monolithic object.
